plugins.name: loomwright
plugins.description: Loomwright v15.47.0 — a plan-first, multi-agent development system for Claude Code. Launch Pad turns a raw goal into a reviewed, Supervisor-ready brief; Supervisor executes it autonomously across parallel git worktrees with sequential merges and a post-merge self-heal pass; dedicated agents handle code review, adversarial red-teaming, and dual-agent QA. Adds standalone PR review-and-heal via /review-pr (bounded review→fix→re-review loop against any open PR, never auto-merges), continuous autonomous mode with stacked PRs, advisory cross-session project memory (human-gated, provenance-verified, worktree-safe) with reflective distillation into bounded LESSONS and harvested `.agent/rules/` conventions delivered as a pull request via /dreaming, an advisory System Twin foundation (per-subsystem System Contracts with sole-writer/hash-chained provenance, blast-radius prediction (depends-on + derived dependents) with incident history, post-merge conformance + benchmark proof, and compounding trend insights — propose-only, subordinate to CLAUDE.md), on-demand capability scanning via /capability-check (adoption + product-direction modes), on-demand PR review-churn root-cause analysis via /pr-postmortem, a local Obsidian-friendly insights dashboard via /insights and a shareable linked Obsidian vault via /obsidian, clickable desktop and phone notifications at human-decision gates, a /setup memory module that puts a repo's Twin memory stores under version control in place (gitignore negation + repo allowlist, consent-bearing, reversible), an opt-in /setup statusline module wiring a one-line run report into the status bar (backup-first, and a status line you already have is preserved rather than overwritten), an opt-in /setup ui module serving The Floor — a local, loopback-only page rendering the current run as five pipeline stages above one lane per agent, where a lane that stops receiving events visibly stalls and nothing animates that is not backed by a recorded event, now also carrying a browsable rules view and a churn view over the postmortem ledger (nothing scored or ranked, every correlation shown with its evidence), reachable directly via the new /ui command (the operational half — serve/stop plus a human-curated project registry, so one server on one port shows any registered project chosen in the page rather than by which directory a terminal was launched in; install/uninstall stay with /setup ui), where the page can now also add, forget, scan and stop from the browser behind a four-part guard — a per-run token carried in a custom header (which forces a preflight a hostile tab cannot satisfy) plus Origin and Host validation, because a loopback port is not a security boundary in a browser), a /handoff --publish flag that emits the existing catch-up digest as a shareable point-in-time snapshot, and opt-in GitHub-issue telemetry. Project memory and lessons are always advisory and subordinate to CLAUDE.md, and every promotion is human-gated. 14 agent roles, 41 reusable skills, 24 quality gate hooks, 22 slash commands, and persistent agent memory. Full version history lives in CHANGELOG.md.

plugins.name: stackpack
plugins.description: Stackpack v1.0.0 — generic tech-stack reference skills (Next.js, NestJS, API-gateway patterns, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker) spun out of Loomwright; 18 skills, no agents/commands/hooks. Install alongside loomwright@atelier.

plugins.name: mysql-mcp
plugins.description: Mysql-mcp v1.0.0 — the read-only MySQL MCP server (vikashruhil-mysql-mcp via uvx) spun out of Loomwright. Resolves DB_HOST/DB_USER/DB_PASS/DB_NAME(/DB_PORT) from the environment. No agents/commands/skills/hooks.
